name: Example: Dirt
author: byo-pop examples
description: Dirt tiles, as in Jewel Quest: they hold no gem and stop falling gems, which slide past them diagonally. A match next to a tile takes a layer off it (it has a crack for each layer left), and the last layer leaves a cell for gems. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Tiles
settings.help: Where the dirt starts and how many layers it has. Gems below a shelf come only past its ends and its gap.

settings.label: Points a layer
settings.help: Points for each layer cleared, times the level's point multiplier.
